versions.author: Boris Delange
versions.message: Vocabulary update: re-resolved against OMOP vocabulary v5.0 29-AUG-26 (previously v5.0 27-FEB-26). 23 -> 27 concepts. Added 4 (new or reclassified descendants in the new release): Extended spectrum beta-lactamase producing Enterobacter asburiae (37464346); Extended spectrum beta-lactamase producing Enterobacter cancerogenus (37464347); Extended spectrum beta-lactamase producing Enterobacter cloacae subspecies dissolvens (37464348); Enterobacter hormaechei subsp. hoffmannii (37465634). 2 concept names updated by the vocabulary (e.g. 'Multiple drug-resistant Enterobacter asburiae' -> 'Multidrug-resistant Enterobacter asburiae').
